'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male NPC student found next to '''Caryl'''. They can be found nearby the Synth Armament Crafting Bay area in [[Startorch Academy]].

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
:'''Caryl:''' Impressive. Charging into an active Voidworm zone alone, and even getting the Academy to revoke your punishment... Should've guessed it'd be you, Miles.
:'''Miles:''' Well, I collected a lot of samples. Even cleared out the Tacet Discords there...
:'''Caryl:''' Just spit it out... How badly did you wreck the motorbike this time? And don't think my lab runs on goodwill. If I keep applying for more funding, the Academy is going to get suspicious. 
:'''Miles:''' Just fix it. I'll cover the costs. I even saved a few samples for you. Partnership at its finest.
:'''Caryl:''' So it's not just repairs, huh? Come on, what else do you want me to slap on this time?
:'''Miles:''' A Hover Cannon.
:'''Caryl:''' That's it? Doesn't sound like your usual style at all. The motorbike you modded last time was basically a light tank.
:'''Miles:''' And a few jet lift thrusters on top of that.
:'''Caryl:''' Ohh, I see. This time, you want to turn your motorbike into a light fighter jet?!
:'''Miles:''' The project needs it.
:'''Caryl:''' ...You say it's for the project, but we both know it's so you can dash into the dunes and rescue people.
:'''Miles:''' ...We've hit peak Void Storm season. The Voidworms have been pulling double shifts.
:'''Caryl:''' Fine, fine... Guess I've already hitched myself to your pirate ship. How's this: a controllable jet-stream field-lift module, and a full-range companion-flight drone fire support system. If you're good with that, I'll send you the schematics tomorrow.
:'''Caryl:''' Oh, and here's another treat for you: the StarBurst-6090 Auxiliary Turbocharger. If things get dicey, just fire it up.
:'''Miles:''' Kinda overkill... but thanks.
:'''Caryl:''' ...Listen. If anything happens to you, I won't be able to walk away from it either. Only you can push the gear I build to its absolute limit.
:'''Miles:''' ...Got it.
----
;After {{Quest|Starlights from Yesterdays}}
:;'''Miles''' What's with that look, Caryl?
:;'''Miles''' What, disappointed I'm still alive?
:;'''Caryl''' You *New Federation curse*... I just held your FUNERAL yesterday!

:Two students who look familiar are in the middle of a fight. You think you saw them with the rune search team during the Aleph-1 crisis.
:{{DIcon|Option}} (Listen) 
::'''Caryl:''' What are you laughing at? Eat this!
::'''Miles:''' Gah! Khk... cut it out! If you need to check if this is a dream, why don't you punch yourself?
::'''Caryl:''' Oh, sure. Sure, Miles. Now I get why the President and everyone didn't react. You weren't dead after all!
::'''Caryl:''' So what the hell was that?! You send me a photo of the Royan runes, say, "Take care of my family for me," then log off. What was I supposed to think?!
::'''Miles:''' Chill. I know you're pissed, but slow your roll. You know the signal around Voidworm territory is garbage...
::'''Caryl:''' Want your leg broken?! "Bad signal," my ass. Isn't that place, like, your second home? How many times have you driven out there?
::'''Miles:''' I didn't exactly plan on running into a Voidworm! Voidmatter concentrations were through the roof. As soon as it showed up, my Terminal lost signal!
::'''Miles:''' I only managed to keep it circling for a few laps because of that turbocharger you installed. If someone piloting the Exostrider hadn't driven Aleph-1 back...
::'''Caryl:''' ...Good thing I was the one who modded your ride.
::'''Miles:''' Yeah. Still, it's a shame. Once it lost connection with the Threnodian, the Voidworm just... poof. Gone.
::'''Miles:''' Really should've recorded it. You don't get a scene that cool twice.
::'''Caryl:''' You didn't record it? *New Federation curse*, Miles! Don't tell me you ripped out my dashcam again without asking!
:{{DIcon|Exit}} (Leave)
{{Dialogue End}}
